_comment: Reviewed high/critical advisories accepted until an upstream fix exists. Every entry needs a reason. Remove entries as upgrades land; scripts/ci/audit-deps.mjs reports stale ones.

advisories.reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs; affects every published version (<= 4.0.7) with no patched release yet. picomatch is reached only through build tooling and file globbing (astro, vite, @vercel/nft, tinyglobby, anymatch) on patterns written in this repo, never on request input, so the runtime site is not exposed. Remove this entry when a patched picomatch ships and the lockfile picks it up.
